'''Snowcub''' is a [[Water]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Polarpaw]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Snowcub has a great appetite but not so great hunting skills. After finally catching one fish, Snowcub now brings it everywhere as a bluff to cover the fact that there's no catching another one any time soon."

Snowcub is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small polar bear that holds a blue fish in its mouth. Its eyes, snout, and paws are cyan.

Polarpaw's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of the fish to maroon, and its feet and snout become peach in color.

== Evolution Trial ==
Snowcub's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Polarpaw]] you need to complete the following task:

* Feed Snowcub any 30 food items. Gotta eat!
